verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server that lets AI agents interact with the Stripe API, so Terminal resources reachable through that API could be driven by natural-language requests via an agent client. There is no native natural-language interface in the Terminal or Dashboard, and no evidence that the MCP tools cover Terminal operations such as readers, locations or in-person payments. Missing for 10: built-in natural-language command interface, documented Terminal-specific MCP tools or NL workflows, hands-on corroboration of NL operation of Terminal.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: The Stripe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides tools that AI agents can use to interact with the Stripe API
Let your AI agents interact with the Stripe API by using our MCP server.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.stripe.com/mcp
